snippet.title: Wargroove 2: Pocket Edition - Mobile Trailer  [Google Play]
snippet.description:
Pre-order now on the Google Play Store for Android
📱 https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=org.chucklefish.wargroove

Launches July 30th on Mobile!

Take to the battlefield with Wargroove, the award-winning strategy game - now on mobile! Play solo or with friends with Local & Online Multiplayer. 

Choose your Commander and wage turn-based war on battling factions. Design and share maps, cutscenes and campaigns with easy-to-use editors and in-depth customization tools!

Learn more: http://wargroove.com
Follow Chucklefish on Twitter: https://twitter.com/ChucklefishLTD
